children: Overview
US outlet mall operator's Q3 rental revenue and net income both rose yr/yr
Company raised full-year 2026 guidance for net income and FFO per share
Quarterly dividend increased 7% from prior year
Outlook
Tanger raises 2026 net income guidance to $1.08-$1.12 per share from $1.06-$1.13
Company now sees 2026 FFO per share at $2.49-$2.53, up from $2.45-$2.52
Tanger expects 2026 same center NOI growth of 3.5%-4.25%
Result Drivers
TENANT DEMAND - Co said strong retailer demand and limited new supply supported portfolio performance
RENTAL RATE SPREADS - Co reported blended average rental rate spreads of 11% on leases executed in the past year
SAME CENTER NOI GROWTH - Same center net operating income rose 4.2% yr/yr in Q3, supported by leasing and operating strategies
